notes.title: Heroes & Dice Steam Page Is Ready
notes.content: Heroes & Dice is my new game, and its Steam page is now live! Please check it out and add it to your wishlist. It's a really fun game, and the demo will be released soon

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Update notes

A completely new hero is added.
When you lose a combat, you have 1 more try per run.
New UI is added.
Some levels are easier.

notes.title: Some Updates And Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

It's been a short time since I released this game, and I wanted to update you on the future plans.

I've received a lot of feedback that the game is very difficult to play, so I'll be making it a bit easier, at least for the first chapter.

Looking ahead, I plan to release more heroes and possibly introduce another warrior as a selectable character. Additionally, I am considering giving players the option to replay a level if they are defeated.

You can join my discord to share your opinions.

Cheers:)
